parameters.query:
INSERT INTO loan_products
  (source_site, product_name, interest_rate, min_income, min_credit_score, min_age, max_age,
   allowed_employment_types, eligibility_rules, raw_criteria_text, qualitative_criteria_text, last_crawled_at)
SELECT r->>'source_site', r->>'product_name', (r->>'interest_rate')::numeric,
       (r->>'min_income')::int, (r->>'min_credit_score')::int, (r->>'min_age')::int, (r->>'max_age')::int,
       CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r->'allowed_employment_types') = 'array'
            THEN ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r->'allowed_employment_types')) END,
       CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r->'eligibility_rules') = 'array' THEN r->'eligibility_rules' END,
       r->>'raw_criteria_text', r->>'qualitative_criteria_text', now()
FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS r) x
ON CONFLICT (source_site, product_name) DO UPDATE SET
  interest_rate = EXCLUDED.interest_rate, min_income = EXCLUDED.min_income,
  min_credit_score = EXCLUDED.min_credit_score, min_age = EXCLUDED.min_age, max_age = EXCLUDED.max_age,
  allowed_employment_types = EXCLUDED.allowed_employment_types, eligibility_rules = EXCLUDED.eligibility_rules,
  raw_criteria_text = EXCLUDED.raw_criteria_text, qualitative_criteria_text = EXCLUDED.qualitative_criteria_text,
  last_crawled_at = now()
RETURNING product_id, source_site, product_name, interest_rate, allowed_employment_types, last_crawled_at

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ JSON.stringify({ source_site: $json.source_site, product_name: $json.product_name, interest_rate: $json.interest_rate, min_income: $json.min_income, min_credit_score: $json.min_credit_score, min_age: $json.min_age, max_age: $json.max_age, allowed_employment_types: $json.allowed_employment_types, eligibility_rules: $json.eligibility_rules, raw_criteria_text: $json.raw_criteria_text, qualitative_criteria_text: $json.qualitative_criteria_text }) ] }}

parameters.query:
SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       t.employment_type,
       p.qualitative_criteria_text,
       md5('rv4|' || p.qualitative_criteria_text || E'\n' || COALESCE(p.raw_criteria_text, '')) AS criteria_hash,
       left(COALESCE(p.raw_criteria_text, ''), 1500)     AS source_text
FROM loan_products p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(COALESCE(p.allowed_employment_types, ARRAY['Salaried', 'Self-Employed', 'Business'])) AS t(employment_type)
LEFT JOIN qualitative_reviews r
       ON r.product_id = p.product_id AND r.employment_type = t.employment_type
WHERE p.last_crawled_at > now() - interval '7 days'
  AND p.qualitative_criteria_text IS NOT NULL
  AND r.criteria_hash IS DISTINCT FROM md5('rv4|' || p.qualitative_criteria_text || E'\n' || COALESCE(p.raw_criteria_text, ''))
ORDER BY p.product_id, t.employment_type

parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
    INSERT INTO qualitative_reviews (product_id, employment_type, criteria_hash, verdict, caveat, provider)
    SELECT (r->>'product_id')::bigint, r->>'employment_type', r->>'criteria_hash',
           r->>'verdict', r->>'caveat', r->>'provider'
    FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS r) x
    WHERE (r->>'valid')::boolean
    ON CONFLICT (product_id, employment_type) DO UPDATE SET
        criteria_hash = EXCLUDED.criteria_hash, verdict = EXCLUDED.verdict,
        caveat = EXCLUDED.caveat, provider = EXCLUDED.provider, reviewed_at = now()
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM ins) AS saved
